capability: provider-neutral vision normalization, annotation and evaluation support

artifacts.role: Normalize detector outputs, annotate evidence, operate zones and compute reproducible CV metrics

license.rationale: The exact 0.30.1 source revision carries the MIT license. This approval covers source code only, not inference models, wheels or containers used beside it.

notes: Supervision is a toolkit, not a detector, physics model or canonical Clicko contract.
The bundled ByteTrack API is deprecated; a future spike must not create a new dependency on it.

artifacts.role: Minimized hash-locked Linux dependency set for only the selected Supervision modules

license.rationale: The 29-package Linux AMD64 wheel set is hash-locked and bound to a focused SPDX 2.3 SBOM. Ten native/binary packages have hashed notice/object evidence and still require human bundled-library review before commercial approval.

notes: The lock was resolved offline from exact Linux wheels and independently verified with pip --require-hashes.
OpenCV is excluded from this lock and remains a separately governed comparison/provider artifact.
The focused SBOM raw digest is 22d543bc3c7e734454e252fcf60846af2d9f2e81ebf301d1cd876616d0a544c5.
Native bundle evidence raw digest is 3d58dadcd755f7f45e228da0308664d3dc3e2d1798aeb8a674707afb3d5d2465; it is evidence, not legal approval.

artifacts.role: Attested vision worker image containing the approved Supervision subset

license.declared_license: Composite image; SBOM and notices required
license.rationale: A local Linux/AMD64 OCI layout is bound to an immutable image manifest and BuildKit provenance/SBOM attestation, and passed a hardened no-network runtime probe. Human notice review and a promotion-grade signature are still absent.

notes: The current vision worker manifest must continue to advertise no Supervision provider.
Dockerfile.evaluation installs only from a pre-materialized wheelhouse with --no-index and is wired to a manual non-deploying workflow.
The OCI archive SHA-256 is 6507d1ebad6602c378c3dd63bd1762d9cc7ab64b612e28633affb546f33c6b2c; its BuildKit attestation binds by statement subject.
The runtime passed as uid 10001 with network none, read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, pids/memory/CPU limits and providers empty.
No signature exists; provenance and SBOM attestations are not treated as a signature.
This inventory freezes a candidate library boundary; it does not authorize an inference model or provider.
Supervision objects are ephemeral adapter types. RealityContributionV1 and RealityModelV1 remain canonical.
SV-2 passed its frozen synthetic benchmark. The OCI and runtime gates are material, while signature and human legal/native-bundle gates remain open.
